changelog: Refactor bin/uno.py into a 56-line launcher that delegates to the new uno-cli>=1.0.0 PyPI package. The launcher pins UNO_OAUTH_SCOPE=mcp:gpt-image-2 and UNO_ALLOWED_TOOLS=gpt-image-2.* in code so any tool call outside this skill's declared scope is rejected locally before any network request. Add a 'Part of Uno' section to surface the 2000+ tool upgrade path for users who need more than gpt-image-2.
